name: virtuoso-drive
description: Virtuoso Drive on AWS: page, server, database changes, access gate, pipeline scripts and end-to-end tests.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p server && tsc -p db-migrate && tsc -p web && tsc -p edge && tsc -p scripts && tsc -p e2e
scripts.test: vitest run server db-migrate web edge scripts
scripts.test:unit: vitest run server db-migrate web edge scripts --exclude '**/*.integration.test.ts'
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run server db-migrate web edge scripts --coverage
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run repo-checks
